message.content:
{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [],
    "notes": "Operator request accepted as a study plan only. No reserve MW, mean cost, coverage, confidence interval, bootstrap, or dispatch result is generated by the LLM."
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is for an auditable upward reserve-sizing study plan for CISO with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40.0. The evening ramp is treated as observable at decision time through current_load and recent_ramp, not as future information. Numerical outputs such as reserve MW, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region CISO, horizon 180 minutes, and shortfall cost 40.0 are supported. The request explicitly avoids peeking at post-decision forecasts. The study plan is accepted with human approval required before execution.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_decision_time_feature_boundary_using_only_admissible_variables",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "return_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
}
